== Biography ==
Isabella was born 8 April  1850 in Lanarkshire, Scotland  She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-424|John Glasgow]] and [[Forsyth-878|Christina Forsyth]]. <ref>

</ref> 

In 1861 Isabella was a scholar living at 45 Aitchison Street New Monklands with her father and siblings.<ref> (Scotland Census 1861; Parish: new Monkland; ED:7; Page:11; Line:8; Roll:cssct1861_117)</ref> <ref>

Isabella married Thomas Wells 20 Aug 1869 in Calerhead, Lanakshire, Scotland <ref>
'''Marriage''':
"Scotland, Select Marriages, 1561-1910"<br/>

</ref>

In 1871 Isabella was living at 3 McPhee Land Shotts with her husband, one child and her three brothers. They also had a general servant living with them. The men were all coal miners<ref> (Scotland Census 1871; Parish: Shotts: ED:5 ; Page: 13; Line: 10; Roll: cssct1871_119)</ref>

Isabella arrived  In New South Wales, Australia aboard the Samuel Pimsoll on 12 June 1879. She was taveling wiht her husand, Thomas, and 4 children between the ages of 1 and 7. They were Christina, William, Margaret and Susan. <ref>
